what: 2026 link model (app/detectors/link_2026.py): character pieces of the whole link, logistic regression
data: urlscan.io collection on this PC (OpenPhish / PhishTank phishing + real sites' pages, 2026) + Chrome UX Report real 2026 sites

split.test: 2026-10-25 and later, sites never seen in training + another 25% of the real sites

level_rule: alert: only 0.5% of each kind of real calibration link reaches it (raises the score); verify: 5% (a note only)
keep_rule: kept only if, on the same later links, the whole engine with the new model has a higher AUC and catch rate than without a 2026 model (at most 1 point more real links / real free-hosted sites flagged) AND than with the installed model (catches at least as many, at most 0.2 points more real links / real free-hosted sites flagged), and plain personal projects (my-portfolio.vercel.app ...) stay below 51
note: the installed model may have trained on a few of the real Chrome UX Report test sites (their split depends on the collection), which can only make the installed model look better - not the new one
